title: Employee On-Boarding: Induction & Orientation
overview: The first few days of employment are crucial in shaping a new hire’s experience and long-term success within the organization. A well-structured onboarding process can create a positive and lasting impression, setting the foundation for a productive and fulfilling work journey. This course provides a comprehensive guide to managing the onboarding process from start to finish. Participants will learn how to design impactful onboarding programs that foster engagement and help new employees integrate smoothly into the organization.
audience: This course is designed for HR professionals involved in recruitment, training, and employee orientation. It is also beneficial for non-HR managers and team leaders who are responsible for introducing new employees to their respective departments.
methodology: The course is highly interactive, featuring workshops, case studies, group activities, roundtable discussions, and presentations to ensure active participation and retention of key concepts.
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Distinguish between company induction and job orientation
Outline the benefits of induction and orientation programs for both employees and the organization
Define the roles and responsibilities of stakeholders involved in the onboarding process
Create a comprehensive information package for new employees
Prepare and deliver an engaging induction presentation
Design and implement a complete onboarding program tailored for new hires
